<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 141.115364, assuming a protonated ion ([M+H]⁺), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈140.1081 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂N₂O matches this mass within a few millidaltons, the closest reasonable composition using C, H, O and an additional element (N). Hence the molecular formula is C7H12N2O.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12N2O</final_answer>
